_key.description: GenCC submission identifier and Ensembl gene ID joined by an underscore.

_from.description: Handle of the disease ontology term from the submission's disease_curie.

_to.description: Handle of the Ensembl gene resolved from the submission's HGNC id.

sgc_id.description: GenCC submission identifier and version number, joined by a dot.

inverse_name.description: Predicate for the gene-to-disease direction. Identical to name; the relationship is symmetric.

hgnc.description: HGNC identifier of the gene, used to resolve the Ensembl gene handle.

gene_symbol.description: HGNC symbol from the GenCC submission.

term_name.description: Disease title from the GenCC submission.

classification.description: GenCC evidence classification of the gene–disease assertion.

moi_id.description: HPO identifier for the asserted mode of inheritance.

moi_name.description: HPO label for the asserted mode of inheritance.

submitter.description: Display name of the GenCC member group that submitted the assertion.
enum: Baylor College of Medicine Research Center
King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Center
University of Washington Center for Rare Disease Research (UW-CRDR)

pmids.description: PubMed identifiers from the submission's submitted_as_pmids field. Empty when none were given.

source_url.description: GenCC page for this submission, using the sgc_id.

class.description: Evidence tier for the underlying data, taken from the associated files_filesets record.

method.description: How the association was assigned, taken from the associated files_filesets record.

label.description: Same value as method, taken from the associated files_filesets record.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the IGVF file the GenCC submissions table was read from.

accessible_via.return: sgc_id, hgnc, gene_symbol, term_name, classification, moi_id, moi_name, submitter, pmids, class, method, label, files_filesets, source, source_url
